claims.text: Gaius distinguishes jurisdiction and the duration of a magistrate’s authority in Roman procedure. Victor’s later account describes Huneric’s succession, regulation of Carthage assemblies and persecution, including execution and sale overseas. A procedural limit and a coercive royal decree are different powers. Separately dated, translated legal and polemical witnesses do not make western fragmentation a simultaneous transfer of identical local government.
